name: pgpulse
description: Postgres query profiler + Redis cache layer + fault-tolerant job queue (BullMQ, Redis Sentinel, Patroni Postgres HA)

scripts.queue:baseline: npm run build && node dist/queue/bench.js baseline
scripts.queue:kill: npm run build && node dist/queue/bench.js kill
scripts.queue:failover: npm run build && node dist/queue/bench.js failover
